Container.Name: belltower
Container.Overview:
Belltower is a small, self-hosted, single-user issue tracker for your homelab: a Trello-style board with cards, labels, checklists, attachments, due dates, a calendar, full-text search and recurring tasks. Everything lives in one SQLite database under /data, and it runs fully offline.
Optional extras: a public submit page so friends and family can report problems (e.g. "Plex is down"), API tokens and an Uptime Kuma webhook that open tickets automatically, Discord notifications, nightly backups, and Claude-drafted tickets if you add an Anthropic API key.
On first start the container log prints a one-time setup code; open the WebUI and use it to choose your password (or set Password below).

Branch.TagDescription: Release candidates: the next stable version, for testing

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to open the app on, e.g. http://tower:8080.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, attachments and backups. SQLite should not go through Unraid's user-share (FUSE) layer: keep this share on a pool with Exclusive access, or use the pool path directly (e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/belltower).

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, this is the login password and it can't be changed in the app. Leave empty to choose a password in the browser using the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on Claude drafting in Add ticket (see docs/AI-DRAFTING.md for what is sent and what it costs). Empty keeps the app fully offline.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy
Config.Description: Only if a reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) sits in front of the app: its IP address(es) or CIDR ranges, comma-separated, e.g. 192.168.1.20. Never 'true'.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in Data (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in Data (Unraid default: 100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File-creation mask for new files in Data.
